description: Reorder the items of an owned Library List. orderedItemIds must contain every current item ID exactly once, in the new order. Show the user the proposed order first; call with confirmed=true only after they confirm. Use the listId and expectedVersion from the latest library_list_get. On library_version_mismatch, read the list again and reconsider the change; never retry blindly. Library Lists only, not trip checklists.

confirmed.description: True only after the user explicitly confirms this exact change. Without it the tool changes nothing and returns the change for review.

expectedVersion.description: Opaque version from the latest library_list_get or Library List tool result.

listId.description: Library List ID from library_lists_search or library_list_get.

orderedItemIds.description: Every current item ID exactly once, in the new order.

name: library_list_items_reorder
title: Reorder Library List Items
